explanation: Boston's tenant eviction protections exist only as a home rule petition (H.3744) seeking state authorization; the excerpted bill history shows only committee referral and reporting-date extensions, with no enactment. The city's adopted ordinance (HSNA) only requires notice of rights and does not halt evictions, so no city-level just cause eviction rule is shown.
quote: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
